All ages welcome (under-10s free); under-18s must be accompanied by an adult and must complete the game by 7:00 PM due to pub licensing laws (start by 3:00 PM recommended). Dog-friendly.

   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Advance booking required (non-refundable; date changes restricted). All ages welcome, but under-18s must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times. Children aged 3 and under enter free.

   * **Core Format:** Sci-fi starship bridge command simulator blending immersive theatre, physical consoles, and branching narrative.    * **Typical Duration:** Allow 2 hours total (includes briefing, uniform fitting, and live mission).

   * **Ideal Group Size:** 4 to 14 crew members (minimum 4 to operate the ship).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Advance booking online. Standard missions are strictly ages 16+ (private "Cadet Missions" available for ages 11+). On-site bar ("The Mess") requires physical ID under Challenge 25.

   * **Borough / Area:** Hackney / Shoreditch (Unit 3B, 127 Hackney Road, E2 8GY).
   * **Core Format:** Theatrical speakeasy cocktail experience set inside a penitentiary. Guests slip into orange prison jumpsuits, smuggle in their own liquor past the corrupt Warden, interact with live-actor guards and inmates, and receive four bespoke cocktails crafted by inmate mixologists.

   * **Borough / Area:** Tower Hamlets / Bethnal Green (Pedley Street Station, Arch 63, E1 5BW).

   * **Typical Duration:** 2 hours.
   * **Indicative Price:** £70.00 to £88.00 per person depending on date/time.
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 2 to 6 per table / dining booth.
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Recommended 18+ for evening shows (family-friendly matinees allow ages 5+; under-18s must be accompanied by an adult). Advance booking essential.

#### Category B: Challenge & Escape-Style Activities (4 Options)

   * **Borough / Area:** City of Westminster / West End (22–32 Shaftesbury Avenue, W1D 7EU).

   * **Typical Duration:** Approx. 75 to 80 minutes (over 60 minutes of active gameplay).
   * **Indicative Price:** Standard tickets from £47.00 per person; VIP tickets £52.00 per person.
   * **Ideal Group Size:** Up to 8 players per team (smaller groups are combined with other players unless booking a full private slot).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Ages 9+ (at least one adult 18+ required per team with children aged 9–16). Pregnant guests cannot participate due to physical agility requirements. Advance booking recommended.

7. **Sherlock: The Official Live Game**
   * **Borough / Area:** Hammersmith & Fulham / Shepherd's Bush (Doyle’s Opticians, W12 Shopping Centre, W12 8PP).
   * **Core Format:** Cinematic escape room and mystery thriller co-written by *Sherlock* creators Steven Moffat and Mark Gatiss.    * **Typical Duration:** 90 minutes.
   * **Indicative Price:** From £35.00 to £40.00 per adult (£30 for kids; £99 family pass).
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 4 to 6 players per detective squad.
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Ages 10+ (under-18s must be accompanied by an adult). The speakeasy bar is 18+ for alcoholic drinks. Advance booking required.

   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Ages 9+ for standard spy missions (under-16s must be accompanied by an adult); *Post Mortem* is strictly 18+. Advance online booking required.

   * **Typical Duration:** 80 to 90 minutes total (60 to 75 minutes inside the room plus briefing and debrief).
   * **Indicative Price:** From £25.00 to £35.00 per person depending on team size and day (Sunday team flat rates available).
   * **Ideal Group Size:** 3 to 6 players (optimum 4 to 5).
   * **Booking & Age Restrictions:** Designed for adults and teens; ages 9+ permitted with an adult. Advance booking required.

Here are the most common questions you have asked us. Contact us if you have any other questions.

What kind of things will I do in the games?

You’ll decipher clues, uncover hidden locations, communicate with characters, solve physical puzzles, interact with people you meet, and make choices that affect your path in the story… Watch this video to find out more.

When can I play HiddenCity?

The games run seven days a week, at times stated in Explore the Games.

When do I choose my time slot?

You can either choose a time slot at the time of booking, or later when you are setting up your teams. You can change your date and time slot at any time before you play.

When do I set up my teams?

You'll set up your teams after you have booked. You can do this straight after booking, or at a later point.

How do I set up my teams?

Sign in to your game, and assign players into teams of 2-6 players. Choose a team captain and team name for each team. Provide an email address and mobile number for each team captain.

How do I start my game?

Once you have set up your teams, team captains will receive a confirmation email and message (via WhatsApp or SMS) from HiddenCity, which includes your start location. On the day, when you are at the start location and ready to play, the captain of team 1 starts the game by replying 'begin' to the message from HiddenCity.

Who will receive messages?

All players can be set up to receive messages, via WhatsApp or SMS. Once you have set up your teams, each team captain will get a message from HiddenCity. Captains can reply with a teammate’s mobile number e.g. “07900 123 123”. The teammate will then recieve a message, asking them to provide their details. Once that's done they’ll also be sent clues, and can reply on behalf of your team. Add further teammates in separate messages.

You can also add teammates in the same way at any point during the game.

How much do messages cost?

WhatsApp messages that you send and receive are done so via cellular connection or Wifi, so as long as you haven’t exceeded your mobile data allowance, or you’re connected to a free Wifi network, your mobile provider won’t charge you for these. If your phone is roaming, data charges might apply.

SMS messages that you send are charged at your standard network rate, or may be free with your phone package. There is no charge to receive SMS messages.

How do the games work with multiple players?

With two or more players you'll set up teams of up to 6 players. If you have multiple teams you'll play competitively head-to-head, in a race to the finish.

Can I add more players or teams?

Yes – sign in to your game using the Game ID and password emailed to the lead organiser, and you'll see an option to add players.

Can I change my team details?

Yes – you can change your team captains and mobile numbers any time before you begin, by signing in to your game.

Can I change the date and time of my game?

Yes – you can change the date or time of your game by signing in to your game and clicking on "update" next to the date or time window.

Can I get a refund?

Yes – the games are fully flexible, so you can get a refund if you don't play. Gift vouchers are non-refundable.

If we play with multiple teams, will we follow each other?

Generally not – teams usually separate as they solve clues at different speeds.

IS MY TICKET REFUNDABLE?

Tickets are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged. You can, however, take advantage of Ticket Refund Protection via our partner Secure My Booking. Please see our Terms and Conditions for more information.

CAN I CHANGE THE DATE OF MY TICKETS?

Unfortunately, we do not allow tickets to be exchanged or altered after booking.

DO I NEED TO PRINT MY TICKET?

No, you do not need to print your ticket.

When you book, you will receive a unique QR code via email from our ticketing partner On The Stage.

Simply show this at the door!

CAN I PURCHASE TICKETS ON THE DAY AND AT THE VENUE?

Tickets on the door are subject to availability and therefore we cannot guarantee entry if you do not book in advance. We recommend you book tickets in advance as this will guarantee the best price and because some timeslots sell out well in advance.

CAN I TRANSFER MY TICKET(S) TO ANOTHER PERSON?

Unfortunately, we do not allow the exchange or transferring of your tickets.

CAN I PURCHASE A PHANTOM PEAK GIFT VOUCHER?

Phantom Peak will return on 4th December 2026 and Gift Vouchers will be available soon for our new home at Westfield Stratford City.

Until they are available, you can find out more about our new venue and sign up to the waitlist for ticket releases.

CAN I MAKE A GROUP BOOKING?

Yes, group bookings are available for Phantom Peak.

For groups of 10+, please enquire today for more information on group rates and availability. We can accommodate groups of various sizes and can customise your experience to meet your specific needs.

Whether you're planning a corporate team-building event, a birthday party, or a family reunion, Phantom Peak is the place to be!

DO YOU OFFER STUDENT DISCOUNT?

Expanded FAQs snippet: QUESTIONS ABOUT THE EXPERIENCE
WHAT IS PHANTOM PEAK?

Phantom Peak is an open-world immersive experience. Step into a real life video game and explore the entire town at your own pace. Your adventure, your way. Time moves on and there are new stories to discover every 3-4 months.

You'll go on a series of trails, where you'll be tasked with helping the townsfolk. You'll use our Jonassist Web App to explore the town, which can be accessed on your mobile phone. You'll need to find clues on noticeboards, watch videos, interact with technology and speak to characters to progress. There are new trails every season, and most people complete 1-2 per visit.

Throughout your visit, there are opportunities for great Food & Drink including speciality cocktails and sweet treats. You can also have a shot at games across town including Platyhooks by the lake or the carnival games inside.

WHERE IS PHANTOM PEAK?

Phantom Peak London isn't open just yet, but we will be at Phantom Peak, Chestnut Plaza, Westfield Ave, Montfichet Rd, London E20 1GL

IS THERE AN AGE REQUIREMENT?

Everybody is welcome at Phantom Peak! Tourists under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times.

HOW LONG IS THE EXPERIENCE?

Your ticket gives you access to Phantom Peak for the full experience, which lasts up to four hours.

Upon entry, you will be able to explore the town until the opening ceremony begins. This is usually 20 minutes after the first entry. Around 30 minutes before the end of the experience, tourists will need to return to Town Square for the Closing Ceremony.

While you are able to leave at any time, re-entry is not permitted. We recommend staying for the entire Phantom Peak experience.

WHAT TYPE OF CLOTHING SHOULD I WEAR?

We recommend wearing comfortable, sensible shoes & clothing as the experience requires walking around a large town.

Some tourists like to dress up, please see our Roleplaying Guidelines for more information about what is appropriate.

Please note that real or fake weapons are strictly prohibited. These are not allowed in the venue and you may be denied entry.

ARE THERE FLASHING LIGHTS, STROBE, HAZE OR OTHER EFFECTS TO BE AWARE OF?

Yes - Phantom Peak uses lighting effects throughout, from point of entry,  which is an integral part of the experience. These lighting effects include flashing lights, haze and loud noises.

Phantom Peak does not use strobe lighting, however there are recurring flashing lights, especially during the Opening and Closing ceremony.

Please see our Accessibility FAQs for more information, or contact us if you have any questions.

IS THERE FOOD AND DRINK AVAILABLE?

There is food & drink available throughout your visit to Phantom Peak London.

We offer a variety of alcoholic & non-alcoholic drinks including speciality cocktails & mocktails. We have multiple bars on site, which are opened depending on the season.

Unless specified, your ticket does not include food & drink and these must be purchased separately.

Please note, it is against our Terms and Conditions to bring Food or Drink from outside into our venue. There are bins on entry for anything that cannot be permitted in the experience.

CAN I TAKE PHOTOS OR RECORD THE EXPERIENCE?

You are free to take photos and videos of your experience using a mobile phone or small camera. We cannot permit professional recording equipment unless previously authorised prior to your visit. 

If you take any photos or videos, please share them with your friends & family, or with us on Social Media!

CAN I BE SEATED DURING THE EXPERIENCE?

There are some chairs, benches, and other places for tourists to sit down while at Phantom Peak. These are located across the town.

The experience is best experienced when you move around the town. You will need to interact with technology, the set, and our live actors throughout to really get the most out of Phantom Peak. In many instances, there won't be an option to sit down during these interactions.

You may find yourself queuing when you first arrive with no seating available.

ARE THERE TOILETS?

Yes, there are toilets available on site for all guests to use including baby changing facilities and accessible toilets. Please note that all of our toilets are gender neutral.

DO I NEED TO SPEAK TO PEOPLE?

You will find yourself speaking to people while at Phantom Peak - however, there's nothing to be worried about, our townsfolk will adjust to you. The more you give to Phantom Peak, the more it gives back.

Phantom Peak is best experienced through 'trails'. They are mini stories, or quests, to complete throughout town. Each season, there are at least 10 trails to complete and each one takes about an hour.

A trail is a series of steps, including interacting with technology, our set, and live actors.

CAN YOU BRING PETS TO PHANTOM PEAK?

Unfortunately not. Phantom Peak can only grant access to registered or validated service dogs. We advise you contact us in advance to discuss your visit.

WHAT TIME SHOULD I ARRIVE?

We recommend you arrive up to 30 minutes before your ticketed time. This gives you time to check in, explore and soak up the atmosphere! Late arrivals may be admitted where possible, but entry cannot be guaranteed once the show has started.

Visiting on a concert or match day?

Phantom Peak is a short walk from London Stadium and the area can become extremely busy during major events. On these days, please allow an additional 30–60 minutes for your journey.

IS IT AN INDOOR OR OUTDOOR EXPERIENCE?

Phantom Peak London is a fully indoor experience, so you can enjoy your visit to town whatever the weather!

DO YOU OFFER PARTNERSHIP OR MEDIA OPPORTUNITIES?

Yes, we do offer partnership and media opportunities for Phantom Peak. If you are interested in partnering with us, please send an email to our team at contact@phantompeak.com.

ARE THERE LOCKERS AVAILABLE?

Smart lockers are available to rent for coats, small bags and loose belongings. They are subject to availability and offered on a first-come, first-served basis. Unfortunately, we cannot accommodate large suitcases, oversized luggage or buggies. Westfield Stratford City also offers a cloakroom service - see more on their website.

CAN I VISIT IF I AM PREGNANT?

Ultimately, this is a decision you must make for yourself. There are flashing lights and some sudden loud noises. On busy days, there may be large crowds with little seating available.

We believe that the experience is suitable for pregnant guests. You explore Phantom Peak at your own pace but it does involve walking across a large venue to various parts of the town. 

If you have any questions, you can contact the team at contact@phantompeak.com

WHAT ABOUT INFANTS / BABIES?

Infants are welcome at Phantom Peak. Please choose a free infant ticket when booking your tickets. Children aged 3 and under visit for free with these tickets. Everybody under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a paying adult at all times.

Please note that there is no buggy park at Phantom Peak, and limited locker space. We do have baby changing facilities available. 

You can contact us for more information at contact@phantompeak.com

WHERE CAN I GET TICKETS?

Tickets for Phantom Peak London are coming soon and will be available right here at phantompeak.com
That's the website you are on right now, so you're in the right place.

FAQ Answers snippet: HOW LONG IS A SESSION OF BRIDGE COMMAND?

You should allow two hours from your arrival time for your booking. The high level of autonomy that you and your fellow players will have means the exact amount of time you spend on your ship can vary.

HOW MUCH ARE TICKETS FOR BRIDGE COMMAND?

Individual tickets start from £49. Prices vary depending on the type of mission and group size, and you can see the latest availability on our Tickets page.

Permalink

WHAT IS THE MAXIMUM AND MINIMUM CREW SIZE?

A ship requires a minimum of four crew members to operate. It can accommodate a crew of up to 14 people, all of whom will have jobs to do.

Please note that unless you buy all the tickets for a specific slot, you are likely to be playing with other bookers who have purchased tickets for the same slot. To book a ship for exclusive use for your group, book a Private Mission.

If you're a small booking or an individual, but would like to play with a full bridge crew of actors, consider our Elite Crew bookings.

Permalink

DO YOU OFFER GROUP BOOKINGS?

Yes, we offer group bookings at Bridge Command. Whether you’re bringing friends, celebrating a birthday, or organising a corporate event, your crew can take over the starship for a private mission.

For smaller groups, our Elite Crew Booking option lets actors fill in as your fellow officers so you still get the full starship experience.

Permalink

WHAT SHOULD I WEAR?

Wear comfortable shoes! You won't be doing much running, but a starship is a place for sensible footwear.

Uniforms are provided to all players, and can be worn like overalls. For this reason any attire is welcome, although long skirts and dresses that cannot easily be tucked into overalls are not recommended, and jeans can lead to the uniforms being a tight fit, so are best avoided.

Permalink

CAN I TAKE PHOTOS OF MY GAME?

Photography using mobile phones is permitted, as long as you secure consent from those who will be in the photograph, including Bridge Command staff. Video is not permitted.

Please do not bring professional camera equipment on your mission, you will be asked to leave this behind.

Permalink

DO YOU SELL DRINKS?

Yes. The venue has a bar which will usually be open both before and after your booking. 

To visit our bar without attending a mission, you can buy a Bar Ticket, the price of which includes a free drink.

Permalink

DO YOU SELL FOOD?

The Mess (our bar) has three flavours of potato crisps available.

What is it? 

Co-scripted by BBC’s Sherlock creators Steven Moffat and Mark Gatiss, ‘Sherlock: The Game Is Now’ begins with the master detective mysteriously missing in action. Enter you and your hand-picked gang of fellow sleuths, tasked with solving a juicy selection of three-patch problems during a 90-minute sesh in a secret central London location. Naturally, you’ll get help (and hindrance) from original cast members, including the high-functioning sociopath of 221B Baker Street himself. 

The journey begins in ‘Doyle’s Opticians’ (as in Arthur Conan), a cover for a ‘spy training agency’ that looks so realistic shoppers have been wandering in asking to get their eyes tested. Listen carefully and you’ll hear Dr John Watson’s (Martin Freeman) voice on the speakers. With the guidance of an actor, you’re ushered in to a secret room to start your mission as rookie spies out to rescue Mycroft. But the play within the play really starts at 221B Baker Street, an exact replica of Sherlock’s living room, recreated with the help of the show’s designer. Maniacal Irish villain Jim Moriarty (Andrew Scott), exasperated Dr Watson (Martin Freeman) and supercilious Mycroft  (Gatiss again) all pop up through footage featuring that familiar quick and caustic logorrhea. 

Why go? 

For an escape room without the cheesy patter delivered by plummy-voiced drama school grads. Everything is designed to test your mental agility, so there are no physical tasks here – it’s all about opening the door to your mind palace. 

Don’t miss

The next door experience ‘Sherlock: The Mind of Moriarty’, in which you travel through the devious villain’s memories to defeat him from the inside. Oh, and don’t miss the secret speakeasy cocktail bar, either. 

When to visit

The escape room runs escapes from Tuesday to Sunday and every day of the week during the school holidays.

Ticketing info

Prices start from £30 per children and £35 for adults, with family tickets availbel for £99 (two adults and two kids aged 10 or over).

We’re located at 90 Worship Street, London, EC2A 2BA. You can reach us easily from Old Street, Shoreditch High Street, Moorgate and Liverpool Street Stations.

DO YOU HAVE A CLOAKROOM?

We do not have a cloakroom, but all tables are fitted with under-table bags and hooks. If you have any large items, please speak to our venue team to see if we can store these safely for you.

SHOULD I LET YOU KNOW OF ANY MEDICAL CONDITIONS IN MY GROUP?

The show contains flashing lights, videos and haze machines throughout, so may not be suitable for guests with epilepsy or severe respiratory problems.

IS THERE DISABLED ACCESS?

Yes, we are wheelchair accessible, and have specific tables which would be suitable. Please let us know in advance or contact bookings@hijingo.com for more information.

As a bingo venue, we are strictly 18+.

IS THERE A DRESS CODE?

There is no dress code. We want all guests to feel comfortable, as long as they are not dressed offensively and have something on.

We highly recommend booking your Hijingo games in advance to avoid disappointment. You can book and check live availability on our website.

We do! However, this is subject to availability.

CAN I AMEND MY ONLINE BOOKING?

Please email: bookings@hijingo.com. Amendments and cancellations are subject to our Booking Policy and Terms & Conditions. View full terms here.

### Part 3: The 3 Category Winners

1. **Best Immersive Game Winner: Bridge Command (Vauxhall)**
   * **Why it wins:** It represents the gold standard of live-action immersive gaming in the UK. By foregoing VR headsets in favor of real, tactile starship bridge stations (dials, throttles, radar screens, weapon targeting grids) and pairing the crew with live actors whose characters react to your tactical and moral decisions, it delivers unmatched depth. It completely eliminates awkward self-consciousness through clear, engaging station roles.
2. **Best Escape / Challenge Activity Winner: Sherlock: The Official Live Game (Shepherd's Bush)**
   * **Why it wins:** While *The Crystal Maze* delivers pure physical nostalgia, *Sherlock* executes the superior cerebral challenge. Scripted by Steven Moffat and Mark Gatiss, it incorporates authentic set replicas and bespoke video performances from the original BBC cast. The transition from the fake optician’s shopfront into 221B Baker Street and the post-game secret speakeasy ("The Mind Palace") create a seamless narrative arc that ordinary lock-and-key rooms cannot touch.
3. **Best Overall Alternative Night-Out Pick: Fairgame Canary Wharf**
   * **Why it wins:** It solves the universal problem of activity bars that either feel too childish, overly corporate, or clunky to organize. With its strict 18+ policy, digital RFID score tracking, fairground nostalgia, and street food curated by Burger&Beyond and Taco Collective, it delivers an effortless, highly social competitive buzz without feeling gimmicky or touristy.
